citations.A1: the module-level `_cache` is written once on first call and then read unconditionally, so file changes are never re-read; fix by keying the cache on the file's mtime (or size+mtime) via `os.stat` and reloading when it changes
citations.A2: Adding a TTL (re-read every N seconds) is not a proper fix: it caps staleness rather than eliminating it and still re-reads when nothing changed
citations.A3: Removing the cache entirely and re-reading every call is not the right fix: it trades stale reads for a disk read plus JSON parse on every hot-path call
citations.A4: `path` is ignored once cached, so `get_config('other.json')` returns the first file's data; fix by keying the cache by resolved path
citations.A5: No locking around the check-and-load, so concurrent first calls under threads can each load and race on assignment; fix by guarding the reload with a `threading.Lock`
citations.A6: Mutable shared dict returned by reference lets callers corrupt the cache in place; fix by returning a copy or a read-only mapping
